sources.title: Vision Transformer (ViT) Architecture - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Vision Transformer (ViT) is a deep learning architecture that applies the Transformer model to images. Instead of relying on convolutions, ViTs use self-attention to capture relationships across all image patches, enabling a global understanding of the image.
